import json, resource, subprocess, sys, time, os
def limited_run(doc):
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    def pre():
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (512*1024**2, 512*1024**2))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_STACK, (8*1024**2, 8*1024**2))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (32, 32))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (20, 21))
    t = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project', preexec_fn=pre)
    return p, time.time()-t
